# SHACL shape

A set of conditions that the targeted nodes of an RDF graph must meet, such as which properties are required, which values they may take, and how many times they may appear. Shapes are written in RDF with SHACL, the W3C Shapes Constraint Language, and a validator reports every node that breaks them.
